name: Beneficiary name in Arabic - transliteration matches registered name
description: Transaction failed with NAME_MISMATCH. The beneficiary name in the transaction is in Arabic script ('شركة الأمل للتجارة') while the account API holds the English transliteration 'Al-Amal Trading Co.'. Expected LLM behaviour: verify_account returns ACTIVE with account_name 'Al-Amal Trading Co.'; the agent recognises the Arabic name and the transliteration as the SAME entity and recommends RETRY_AFTER_UPDATE with a suggestion to use the registered (transliterated) beneficiary name.

request.failure_reason: Simulated upstream failure for E2E testing

expected_response.explanation: The submitted beneficiary name 'شركة الأمل للتجارة' is in Arabic script, while the account is registered under the English transliteration 'Al-Amal Trading Co.'. These refer to the same entity, so the mismatch is purely a script/representation difference. Using the registered transliterated name will resolve the rejection.
correction_suggestions: Update the beneficiary name to the registered transliteration: Al-Amal Trading Co.

api_requests.notes: Agent must recognise Arabic script vs English transliteration of the same entity. Suggestions must reference name/beneficiary/match/correct/update/amal.
